entries.2ee5d2dc4556d62d: A holding company that manufactures mechanical parking systems, industrial machinery, switchboards and amusement rides, and performs equipment construction, across three businesses: for manufacturing, for construction, and leisure.
entries.39af8d95a09573f1: This business manufactures and maintains shot blasting machines; manufactures and assembles various industrial machinery parts and parts for agricultural machinery and specialty vehicles; manufactures emulsifying and agitating equipment; designs and builds pure water equipment, wastewater treatment equipment and membrane separation units; designs and builds various tanks, including large food tanks; designs, manufactures and sells fully automatic wire cutting and stripping machines and fully automatic crimping machines; and manufactures and maintains environmental equipment and medical waste treatment equipment. It is carried out by Sanoyas Engineering Co., Ltd., Sanoyas Precision Industry Co., Ltd., Mizuho Kogyo Co., Ltd., Meishiga Kikai (Wuxi) Co., Ltd., Kodera Denshi Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and Sanoyas Entec Co., Ltd., and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,917 million.
entries.676e2e948b2e5391: Owners and managers of large facilities
entries.88423a7deeb4dfab: This business manufactures and maintains mechanical parking systems, manufactures and rents construction elevators, designs and builds air-conditioning, water supply and drainage, and sanitary equipment, manufactures power control panels, distribution boards and switchboards for large facilities and carries out electrical work, and manufactures and sells various control panels and operation panels. It is carried out by Sanoyas Engineering Co., Ltd., Sanoyas Entec Co., Ltd., Happiness Denki Co., Ltd., Shōei Denki Co., Ltd., Shōei Denki System Control Co., Ltd. and Yamagata Kyodo Co., Ltd., and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,526 million.
entries.a5bf065a85c551ab: Operators of amusement parks and leisure facilities
entries.b55ec93a8d198004: This business manufactures and maintains amusement park ride equipment and undertakes the operation and management of amusement park facilities on a contract basis. It is carried out by Sanoyas Ride Co., Ltd. and Sanoyas Ride Service Co., Ltd., and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,383 million.
